notes.title: Father`s Island 2.0 released!
notes.content:
[h1]Ladies & Gentlemen,[/h1] [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25365843/85e6a0770335274249e07e91d2adeed74f302805.png[/img]

we present you today with a little bit pride our 2018 Halloween Edition of "Father's Island" - or, as we called it in earlier announcements, 

[h1][b]Father`s Island 2.0[/b][/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25365843/9d8c00f987d769731ee05845c905ad147040fbde.png[/img]

Why?

Because it is based on the DirectX11 upgrade of the underlying Gamemaker "GameGuru", and it mitigates or entirely eliminates all problems you might have had with our original release.

- IMPORTANT: If you have problems updating to this version, please uninstall and reinstall Father`s Island. [b]Actually, we recommend uninstalling and a fresh install anyway![/b] - 

[u][b]Changes:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] DirectX11 based
[*] Loading times reduced by 30 - 75%, depending on the system
[*] Load only once per session: Smart respawn system
[*] 2 new video scenes
[*] 3 new posters
[*] 2 new side stories in letters
[*] Full PBR support
[*] 37 assets converted to true PBR
[*] Multi-Level vertex painted terrain
[*] Advanced atmosphere light scattering
[*] Fixed some minor bugs and logic issues
[*] Fixed the summoning of the Dragon
[/list]

[u][b]Possible Troubleshooting:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] After you hit the "Start Game" button, just leave your system loading. Even if the game seems unresponsive, it will load (don`t cancel or quit)
[*] If the level fails to load (or an error message appears), open the setup.ini in the installation folder and set
dividetexturesize=1
to
dividetexturesize=4
[*] If Steam keeps reinstalling /or verifying over and over again, please uninstall and reinstall
[*] If you find it too dark / bright / red / whatever, you can adjust ALL rendering options by editing the visuals.ini file
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: 1.09 is live!
notes.content:
Ladies & Gentlemen, welcome to version 1.09!

We have granted Father's Island an extensive visual upgrade. With special thanks to Reshade.me and Mastereffects Guru Marty McFly, we are able to bring you:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/460940/ss_011742c68d37a6090f4dca2207bb5d8fb0ddc849.1920x1080.jpg

[list]
    [*]Advanced Adaptive Bloom
    [*]Lensflare
    [*]Virtual Global Illumination
    [*]FXAA
    [*]Scene-adaptive dynamic color grading
    [*]Improved Ambience Occlusion
[/list] 

[b]And all that with...[/b]

[list]
    [*]Whopping 10 - 25% more FPS
    [*]Cutscenes can now be skipped
    [*]Fixed rabbit chase bug
    [*]Fixed Alicias corpse sequence
[/list] 


KNOWN ISSUES:

[list]
    [*]Some doors can still be glitched through, we keep hunting that one.
    [*]Saved games run 10 - 30% lower FPS after loading. We still HEAVILY recommend starting a new game for each playthrough (is now easier with cutscenses skipping)
    [*]If you look straight into the sky above, you see a line breaking the skybox. No Idea why!
[/list] 

So, fire up Father's Island, start a new game and enjoy the show! ːNaziUfoLeftː

PS: We will keep the Halloween version live for now. No need to rush on that one, Comrades! ːcommieː

notes.title: Performance Patch live!
notes.content:
Last weekend, we launched the first iteration of our performance patch.

Here's the changelist:

[list]
    [*]~ 250MB less memory used
    [*]10 - 30 seconds reduced loading time
    [*]reduced memory-related issues by ~ 80%
    [*]reduced likeliness of "green screen" appearing
    [*]5 - 15% more fps, depending on system
    [*]less LOD-induced Microlags
[/list]

With this patch, we have also changed the installation folder, because some Windows installations out there had a problem with the ' in "Father's" Island.

If you want to be on the safe side, delete the local Father's Island file in your Steam client and re-install afterwards.

Grace Savegame:

Yes, this would require starting a new game. However, we placed a "grace" savegame in slot 3 where you are already on the island and have solved the first puzzles.

Additional information:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/460940/discussions/0/350542683211512104/

notes.title: It's Hammer... - ah, no - it's DEMOtime!
notes.content:
[i]"They don't make demos anymore..."
"Demo versions are a thing of the past..."
"I wish I could try before I buy, but those times are over..."[/i]

We from Homegrown Games beg to differ!

During the creation of the upcoming 1.07 version, we made a little side stroll through the woods and created a playable demo. As it is partially already based on the 1.07 code / shaderbase, it gives also a brief insight into the upcoming version.

[b]Today we have released it here![/b]

[u][b]
What is this DEMO for?[/b][/u]

[list][*]Finding out if your PC runs the game properly
[*]Checking out if you like the game (of course!)
[*]Evaluating if your sanity suffers from this game[/list]

[u][b]
What is the content of this demo?[/b][/u]

[list][*]A part of the island from the final game (~ 20%)
[*]10 - 15% of the encounters, voice overs and cut-scenes
[*]The full intro puzzle + intro video
[*]15% of the other puzzles
[*]1 of the 4 different endings[/list]

If you like it - get it the full game for only $5 or the ːNaziUfoRightːUltimate Conspiracy BundleːNaziUfoLeftː for only $10:

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/869/

Have fun!

notes.title: v1.07 Preview - Top Secret Stuff & Beauty Issues
notes.content:
[h1]Well, the last weeks were quite a ride for us![/h1]

We were asked if we are insane (Spoiler Alert: Yes, we are!). 
We gifted 150 keys to various charities.
We got a lot of more positive feedback, we are still at 80+ % positive reviews here on Steam. 
We got some catchy review tag-lines like "9 / 10, would shag the sheep again" or "Dear Esther and Myst on Crystal Meth".

Press & Radio have covered us in a [i]somehow[/i] positive way...

http://fm4.orf.at/stories/1771601/

...or in a [b][i]really[/i][/b] positive way...

http://www.game-2.de/fathers-island/

...or in an [i]insane[/i] positive way:

http://hubpages.com/games-hobbies/Holy-Grail-of-Atmosphere

No haters yet. This and the fact that we were put onto the same stage as "Dear Esther", "Firewatch" or "Myst", could cloud (haha, no typo here!) our judgement. When an editor tells us he wished that goat simulator had the fulfilled its promise like we did with our games, it is suspicious. Especially as we liked that one (not the copycats, though). And when we read Father's Island being called a candidate for the game of the year, we panic. I mean, WTF?!

Perhaps we have really sacrified too many of our firstborns?!
Have they stolen our creativity-enhancing substances during the last studio visit?

Well, we get it, most of you like our game. And we are very happy and grateful for that. We see that also as a work order to imrpove the game, to make it better, more beautiful, more enjoyable and especially also more accessable for those who still struggle with some elements. 

[b]And that's why we have quite something prepared for the next update, version 1.07, coming in the next days:[/b]

ːfrogrightː Enhanced level of detail without FPS loss or increased memory footprint

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=720928301

ːfrogrightː Better guidance: More landmarks, more visual hints where to go

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=720929731

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=720930953

ːfrogrightː 3 new videos

ːfrogrightː 5 new documents from Operation Paperclip and Hans Kammler

ːfrogrightː 2 of them officially still not de-classified! 

ːfrogrightː 8 new sound experiences

ːfrogrightː Keys that are overlooked easily get a green light if the player is close enough

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=720928975

ːfrogrightː New puzzles and less key hunting

[b]And we got another surprise for you![/b]

All of you who have bought Father's Island, can get the almost-prequel "Into the Dark" for a bargain:

http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/869/?snr=1_5_9__403

(and if you really don't have bought Father's Island yet, you can get it bundled with Into the Dark for only 10$ there!)

And of course, Father's Island will also get a Halloween Edition. But it's too soon to talk about that, comrades! ːcommieː

So far, thank you very much for all your love, support!

Ivan from Homegrown Games

PS: Although we appreciate all your feedback, messages and gifts, please don't mail any more drugs to our street adress. And no, we don't think that texturing is a work best done on Acid. 

[b][u]Edit 12th of July 2016:[/u][/b]

ːcommieːComrades!ːcommieː

Work on the patch has continued, and we also found time to create a very special surprise for all of you out there. It's currently reviewed by Steam, but I hope we get the go for it this week. Also, the 1.07 upgrade will *most* likely be ready by Thursday.

We would like to thank Kouen Hasuki, whose twitch session showed us some issues we still had to fix.

On another note, we were approached by a quite experienced film maker who wants to create a "real" B-Movie out of the story. We will keep you updated about the progress on that! ːNaziUfoLeftː

In the meantime, keep playing!

notes.title: V 1.06 released!
notes.content:
[b] - IMPORTANT: YOU MUST START A NEW GAME - [/b]


[h1] Here we go with v 1.06! [/h1] 

Following the Feedback from AJ0X, one of the Reviewers, we made several improvements to the game. And by doing so, we stumbled across a very annoying bug that we could fix! Yeah!

[u]And here for the changelist:[/u]


[list]
    [*]2 - 5 FPS more depending on scene on system
    [*]broad sliders for adjusting sound & music
    [*]dynamic ressource system: Will try to keep your fps at min. 25
    [*]dynamic ressource system: Will reduce LUA calls when system falls below 20FPS to compensate
    [*]Music set to 45% by default instead of 100%
    [*]Music set 60% in relation to voice overs (you can adjust that in the menu)
   [*]Fixed the window render bug introduced in 1.05
[/list] 

And we fixed a bug that made it very hard to pick up a tool:


[spoiler] In the school, there is a tool in the basement that can be used to open the door to the father's office in the first floor. There was a bug that made it hard to pick up when approached from the wrong angle. Now it should work far better!

Here a link to its location:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=715211660
[/spoiler]

[b] - Keep in Mind: YOU MUST START A NEW GAME - [/b]

Save / Load behaviour basically works properly now. However, as some testers report an FPS loss after loading saved games, [b]we still recommend finishing the game in one session[/b]. 

Have fun!

notes.title: V 1.06 released!
notes.content:
[b] - IMPORTANT: YOU MUST START A NEW GAME - [/b]


[h1] Here we go with v 1.06! [/h1] 

Following the Feedback from AJ0X, one of the Reviewers, we made several improvements to the game. And by doing so, we stumbled across a very annoying bug that we could fix! Yeah!

[u]And here for the changelist:[/u]


[list]
    [*]2 - 5 FPS more depending on scene on system
    [*]broad sliders for adjusting sound & music
    [*]dynamic ressource system: Will try to keep your fps at min. 25
    [*]dynamic ressource system: Will reduce LUA calls when system falls below 20FPS to compensate
    [*]Music set to 45% by default instead of 100%
    [*]Music set 60% in relation to voice overs (you can adjust that in the menu)
   [*]Fixed the window render bug introduced in 1.05
[/list] 

And we fixed a bug that made it very hard to pick up a tool:


[spoiler] In the school, there is a tool in the basement that can be used to open the door to the father's office in the first floor. There was a bug that made it hard to pick up when approached from the wrong angle. Now it should work far better!

Here a link to its location:

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=715211660
[/spoiler]

[b] - Keep in Mind: YOU MUST START A NEW GAME - [/b]

Save / Load behaviour basically works properly now. However, as some testers report an FPS loss after loading saved games, [b]we still recommend finishing the game in one session[/b]. 

Have fun!

Thank you very much for all the feedback, for the bugreports from the forum and via Email.

We have adressed as much as possible for this first patch and we hope you enjoy the game now even more.

    [*]reduced propability of "Green Screen" bug
    [*]fixed several possible Save / Load hickup issues

    [*]Added new splash / loading screens

[/list]
